blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Facing an opponent for the first time, Alex Eala still had British teen Mika Stojsavljevic all figured out in a masterful 6-1, 6-2 win in her Toray Pan Pacific Open debut on Monday in Tokyo, Japan. Eala raced to a 5-0 lead in the opening set after three straight errors from Stojsavljevic.
